# DO NOT TERM-SEARCH THE EXTRACTED TEXT OF THIS WORK

`source_data_text/incoming/1703.vocabulario_de_la_lengua_tagala.santos/
1703.vocabulario_de_la_lengua_tagala.santos.txt` is **1.8 KB from a 956-page
book**. It contains **only Princeton's own rights statement**, which is the sole
page in the PDF carrying a text layer. The 955 scanned pages have none.

**A search of that .txt for `tomate` or `camatis` will return zero — and that zero
means nothing.** It is an empty extraction, not a reading of the book. This is the
same failure mode that produced the Cornell-bulletin false negative earlier in
this project, and the standing chars-per-page QA flags it correctly at
**2 chars/page**.

## The negative recorded for this work was established from page images, not text

- **Part 1, printed p. 837** (PDF p. 823, running head "T ante O"): the run is
Tomar (Gamit) · Tomar (Dahas) · Tomar (Camcam) · Tomar (Boo) · Tomar (Sacop) ·
Tomar (Hinagap) · Tomar (Bagat) · Tomar (Doong) · Tomar (Sahab) ·
Tomar (Tapang) · Tomar (Potic) · **Tonina** · **Tontería** · [catchword] Tonto.
**No *Tomate*, and no *Tomillo*.**
- **Part 2, printed p. xvij** (PDF p. 889, running head "C ante A"): the run is
Camasahan · Camasahan · **Camatayan** *(muerte)* · **Camay** *(mano)*.
**No *camatis*.**
- **Positive controls on the same pages:** *Camote* stands in column 3 of p. xvij;
*Catimon (melón)* at p. xx. Plant and American-crop vocabulary IS present.

Anyone re-checking should render those two pages rather than trust any text file.

## How to navigate this book without OCR

Running heads are `[printed page] [LETTER] ante [LETTER]`, so the alphabetical
position of any leaf can be read from the top of the page. Rough anchors:
PDF 30 = printed 8 (A ante B) · 200 = 186 (B ante O) · 400 = 386 (E ante N) ·
600 = 594 (O ante F) · 750 = 764 (R ante O) · 800 = 814 (S ante U) ·
815 = 829 (T ante E) · 823 = 837 (T ante O) · 850 = 864 (U ante A).
Part 2 (Tagalog→Spanish, three columns, roman pagination) begins near PDF 866:
880 = xj (B) · 889 = xvij (C ante A) · 895 = xxij (D) · 902 = xxx (H) ·
908 = xxxvj (L) · 915 = xliij (MA) · 930 = lviij (P).
